mapper.select: SELECT id, invoice_no, invoice_code, invoice_type, contract_id, initiation_id, customer_id, customer_name, invoice_basis, amount, tax_amount, net_amount, tax_rate, currency, invoice_date, tax_period, title, tax_no, bank_info, address, phone, remark, status, reversed_by_id, attachment_id, approval_comment, applied_by, approved_by, approved_at, issued_by, issued_at, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE invoice_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, invoice_no, invoice_code, invoice_type, contract_id, initiation_id, customer_id, customer_name, invoice_basis, amount, tax_amount, net_amount, tax_rate, currency, invoice_date, tax_period, title, tax_no, bank_info, address, phone, remark, status, reversed_by_id, attachment_id, approval_comment, applied_by, approved_by, approved_at, issued_by, issued_at, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE invoice_no = #{invoiceNo} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pmis_project_invoice SET status = #{status}, approved_by = COALESCE(#{approvedBy}, approved_by), issued_by = COALESCE(#{issuedBy}, issued_by), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, invoice_no, invoice_code, invoice_type, contract_id, initiation_id, customer_id, customer_name, invoice_basis, amount, tax_amount, net_amount, tax_rate, currency, invoice_date, tax_period, title, tax_no, bank_info, address, phone, remark, status, reversed_by_id, attachment_id, approval_comment, applied_by, approved_by, approved_at, issued_by, issued_at, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY invoice_date DESC

SELECT id, invoice_no, invoice_code, invoice_type, contract_id, initiation_id, customer_id, customer_name, invoice_basis, amount, tax_amount, net_amount, tax_rate, currency, invoice_date, tax_period, title, tax_no, bank_info, address, phone, remark, status, reversed_by_id, attachment_id, approval_comment, applied_by, approved_by, approved_at, issued_by, issued_at, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY invoice_date DESC

SELECT id, invoice_no, invoice_code, invoice_type, contract_id, initiation_id, customer_id, customer_name, invoice_basis, amount, tax_amount, net_amount, tax_rate, currency, invoice_date, tax_period, title, tax_no, bank_info, address, phone, remark, status, reversed_by_id, attachment_id, approval_comment, applied_by, approved_by, approved_at, issued_by, issued_at, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY invoice_date DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'ISSUED') AND invoice_type = 'NORMAL' AND deleted = 0
SELECT status, COUNT(1) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT tax_period, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND status = 'ISSUED' AND invoice_type = 'NORMAL' AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY tax_period ORDER BY tax_period
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE status = 'ISSUED' AND invoice_type = 'NORMAL' AND deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE status = 'ISSUED' AND invoice_type = 'NORMAL' AND deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(allocated_amount), 0) FROM pmis_project_payment WHERE status = 'ALLOCATED' AND deleted = 0
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(1) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(department_id, 0) AS department_id, COUNT(1) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY department_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(i.project_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS project_type, COUNT(1) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(inv.amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM pmis_project_invoice inv LEFT JOIN pmis_project_initiation i ON inv.initiation_id = i.id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE inv.deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(i.project_type, 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY total_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT initiation_id) FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 AND initiation_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT TO_CHAR(invoice_date, 'YYYY') AS year, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount, COUNT(1) AS invoice_count, COUNT(DISTINCT initiation_id) AS project_count FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ISSUED' AND invoice_type = 'NORMAL' AND invoice_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TO_CHAR(invoice_date, 'YYYY') ORDER BY year

SELECT TO_CHAR(invoice_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount, COUNT(1) AS invoice_count, COUNT(DISTINCT initiation_id) AS project_count FROM pmis_project_invoice WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ISSUED' AND invoice_type = 'NORMAL' AND invoice_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TO_CHAR(invoice_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT #{limit}
